scope: Combines four immutable independently recomputed fold score reports; reads no raw predictive banks or labels. Cross-checks the completed producer summary, masks, status/availability, per-cycle and equal-cycle regression metrics and precision flags.
comparison: All available reported fields match within 2e-10. Producer records only the unavailable status for equal-cycle strata with empty masks; those were checked by status, not by inventing metric values.
recommendation: Retain F0; do not adopt G01 based on exposed retrospective development comparisons.
